##### Project general facts

Kabbali Hills by Arif Developments is a one-of-a-kind gated villa community where every home is individually designed by an in-house team of architects. Heritage-inspired design meets contemporary clarity, reinterpreting classical inspiration as quiet luxury with refined proportions and flowing spaces. The villas rise from a ground floor to one or two upper levels, with selected homes adding a basement or roof level, offering signature residences with five, seven and eight bedrooms set within private gardens.

Residents enjoy a connected community where living, leisure and convenience coexist. Integrated retail brings cafes, boutiques and everyday essentials together, while a landscaped park, an outdoor children's play area, jogging tracks, an outdoor yoga area and multi-purpose open spaces support an active family lifestyle. Private lounges and beautifully landscaped gardens create serene retreats, and a local community mosque offers a dedicated place of worship within the neighbourhood.

Every villa features Italian-inspired ceilings, premium Italian finishes and fully equipped German-made kitchens with premium Siemens appliances, along with built-in wardrobes with soft-close mechanisms. Homes include a maid's room, a laundry, a private lift, a private pool and a majlis area, with smart home technology throughout. Villas are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Helio is a fast-growing residential district of Ajman, set within Emirates City and known for its calm, family-friendly streets, modern villa communities and expanding retail and services. Parks, mosques, supermarkets and schools serve local families, while the beaches and corniche of Ajman and the cultural attractions of Sharjah are within easy reach for weekends and leisure time.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road connect residents with Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Saudi German Hospital is close by, City Centre Ajman and the American Private School are a short drive away, and Ajman Beach, Al Zorah Beach and Ajman University are within comfortable reach, as are Sharjah International Airport and Dubai International Airport.

Ajman offers freehold ownership to international buyers and some of the most accessible prices in the UAE. Large, individually designed villas with private pools and lifts are in limited supply in the emirate, attracting families seeking space and privacy at a fraction of Dubai prices. Strong road links to Dubai and Sharjah support steady demand from end users and investors, underpinning long-term value.
